mapper.select: SELECT email as userId, nickname, user_name as name, email, '010-0000-0000' as phone, DATE_FORMAT(birth_date, '%Y-%m-%d') as birthDate, gender, DATE_FORMAT(created_at, '%Y-%m-%d') as joinedAt, profile_image as profileImage FROM USER WHERE user_id = #{userId}
SELECT intimacy_level as level, intimacy_score as remainPoint FROM USER_BOT_RELATION WHERE user_id = #{userId} LIMIT 1
SELECT name, CASE WHEN unlock_intimacy_level > #{userLevel} THEN '잠금' ELSE '보유' END as state FROM CHAT_BACKGROUND ORDER BY sort_order ASC
SELECT motion_name as name, CASE WHEN unlock_intimacy_level > #{userLevel} THEN '잠금' WHEN motion_group = 'COMMON' THEN '기본' ELSE '보유' END as tag FROM BOT_MOTION ORDER BY sort_order ASC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM BOT_LETTER WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND is_read = FALSE
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM BOT_LETTER WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND created_at >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 7 DAY)

SELECT letter_id as id, letter_type as type, '메이티' as sender, title, content as preview, CASE WHEN DATE(created_at) = CURDATE() THEN '오늘' WHEN DATE(created_at) = DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 DAY) THEN '어제' ELSE DATE_FORMAT(created_at, '%Y-%m-%d') END as date, NOT is_read as unread FROM BOT_LETTER WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY created_at DESC
SELECT bot_letter_enabled as pushNotice, TRUE as emailNotice, TRUE as gentleTone, TRUE as quickReply FROM USER_SETTING WHERE user_id = #{userId}
